purpose: A 96-layer post-enterprise capability ladder that deepens the frozen VOL-000..420 masterplan without adding top-level volumes.

terminology.note: The count 96 is an organizational discipline inspired by the published GPT-3 175B depth; it is not a claim that current ChatGPT uses a fixed 96-layer architecture.

laws: enterprise superiority is the entry floor
no F96 identity is a top-level volume
generator and evaluator may not self-promote
implementation and independent verification signatures are distinct
hidden chain-of-thought is neither required evidence nor an implementation dependency
frontier qualification expires when material evidence identity changes

strata.name: Authority & Context Sovereignty
strata.summary: Make instruction authority, identity, policy, trust and context assembly explicit before higher cognition can act.

strata.name: Memory & Knowledge Continuity
strata.summary: Turn short-lived model context into governed, temporal, privacy-aware continuity without poisoning or silent contradiction.

strata.name: Retrieval & Evidence Intelligence
strata.summary: Build evidence-first retrieval that can search heterogeneous stores, preserve provenance and distinguish support from plausibility.

strata.name: Reasoning & Metacognition
strata.summary: Add bounded strategy selection, structured reasoning, uncertainty and verifier loops without depending on hidden chain-of-thought.

strata.name: Planning, Search & Long-Horizon Control
strata.summary: Convert goals into bounded executable plans with search, simulation, scheduling, checkpointing and repair.

strata.name: Tools, Actions & Transactional Agency
strata.summary: Make external action privileged, typed, sandboxed, idempotent, reversible where possible, and independently verifiable.

strata.name: Agents, Delegation & Collective Intelligence
strata.summary: Coordinate specialists with strict authority inheritance, leases, handoffs, disagreement resolution and bounded fan-out.

strata.name: Multimodal & World Intelligence
strata.summary: Unify documents, images, speech, audio, video, spatial scenes and computer environments under evidence-preserving contracts.

strata.name: Learning, Adaptation & Outcome Optimization
strata.summary: Learn from outcomes through governed feedback loops while keeping production promotion separate from candidate generation.

strata.name: Model Systems, Training & Compute Fabric
strata.summary: Operate provider, local and native models through a hardware-aware runtime with reproducible lifecycle and rollback.

strata.name: Verification, Safety, Security & Governance
strata.summary: Make correctness, security, privacy, provenance and human authority non-compensable gates rather than soft quality dimensions.

strata.name: Scientific Autonomy & Frontier Operations
strata.summary: Close the loop with observability, chaos recovery, research, adversarial mirror testing, controlled self-improvement and signed finality.

construction_waves.focus: planning, search, tools and transactional action
agents, delegation, multimodal and world intelligence
learning, adaptation, model systems, training and compute
verification, security, frontier operations, scientific autonomy and finality

completion.rule: All 96 layers must be signed_complete with current evidence and F96-096 must carry independent finality evidence.

layers.title: Instruction Authority Lattice
layers.build_contract: Compile system, developer, user, workspace, retrieved and generated instructions into a typed precedence lattice with non-escalation rules.
layers.acceptance_proof: Property tests prove lower-trust content cannot acquire higher instruction authority; replay shows the same authority decision from durable inputs.

layers.title: Intent & Objective Normalization
layers.build_contract: Convert natural-language requests into explicit objectives, constraints, acceptance criteria, forbidden actions and ambiguity records.
layers.acceptance_proof: Golden and adversarial suites show stable intent extraction, explicit unresolved ambiguity, and no silent broadening of user authority.

layers.title: Policy Compilation & Decision IR
layers.build_contract: Compile human-readable policy into a deterministic decision representation usable by tools, agents, retrieval and release gates.
layers.acceptance_proof: Equivalent-policy tests, deny-by-default unknowns, versioned policy receipts and deterministic replay all pass.

layers.title: Identity / Session / Workspace Binding
layers.build_contract: Bind every operation to user, tenant, workspace, project, session and delegated principal identities before context or tools are resolved.
layers.acceptance_proof: Cross-tenant and stale-session tests prove zero unauthorized scope bleed; identity lineage is reconstructable from receipts.

layers.title: Trust-Segmented Context Assembly
layers.build_contract: Preserve trust class, source, freshness, scope and authority metadata through every context compilation step.
layers.acceptance_proof: Injection corpus proves untrusted text cannot be promoted; compiler snapshots preserve source and trust labels end-to-end.

layers.title: Context Budget Optimizer
layers.build_contract: Allocate context budget by policy, utility, freshness, evidence value, cost and model constraints instead of naive truncation.
layers.acceptance_proof: Budget sweeps beat fixed truncation on quality/cost while never trimming non-droppable policy or required evidence.

layers.title: Loss-Bounded Semantic Compression
layers.build_contract: Compress long context into typed summaries with preserved constraints, citations, uncertainty and recoverable source links.
layers.acceptance_proof: Round-trip and entailment checks show mandatory constraints survive; dropped claims remain recoverable from source references.

layers.title: Context Replay & Provenance
layers.build_contract: Persist a replayable context manifest tying every model-visible token span or structured element to source identity and policy decision.
layers.acceptance_proof: Independent replay reproduces the compiled context or emits a precise nondeterminism record; provenance gaps fail closed.

layers.title: Working Memory Controller
layers.build_contract: Maintain bounded task-local state with explicit lifetime, salience, eviction, checkpoint and reset semantics.
layers.acceptance_proof: Stress tests show bounded growth, deterministic eviction policy and correct reset/recovery across retries and resumes.

layers.title: Episodic Memory
layers.build_contract: Store event-like experiences with time, scope, actor, evidence and outcome rather than undifferentiated chat text.
layers.acceptance_proof: Temporal retrieval and deletion tests preserve episode identity, ordering, retention and tenant boundaries.

layers.title: Semantic Memory
layers.build_contract: Promote durable facts and abstractions only through source, confidence, contradiction and scope checks.
layers.acceptance_proof: Contradiction suites keep competing claims distinct; source deletion/retention propagates into derived representations.

layers.title: Procedural Memory
layers.build_contract: Represent reusable procedures as versioned, permission-aware skills with preconditions, postconditions and rollback guidance.
layers.acceptance_proof: Procedure replay is deterministic where expected; stale or unauthorized procedures are rejected before action.

layers.title: Project / World-State Memory
layers.build_contract: Maintain durable project and environment state separately from conversation summaries or model beliefs.
layers.acceptance_proof: Restart and concurrent-writer tests preserve authoritative world state and expose conflicts instead of last-write-wins guessing.

layers.title: Temporal Truth & Contradiction Graph
layers.build_contract: Track claim validity windows, supersession, disagreement and evidence lineage without destructive overwrite.
layers.acceptance_proof: Time-travel queries reproduce historical truth state; contradictory evidence coexists until an explicit reconciliation decision.

layers.title: Memory Privacy, Retention & Deletion
layers.build_contract: Apply classification, consent, retention, export, tombstone and derived-index deletion policies to every memory class.
layers.acceptance_proof: Delete/export drills prove no tombstone resurrection and no stale embeddings/indexes retain prohibited content.

layers.title: Memory Quality & Self-Healing
layers.build_contract: Continuously score usefulness, staleness, duplication, poisoning risk and unresolved conflicts, producing repair candidates rather than silent mutation.
layers.acceptance_proof: Poisoning and stale-memory benchmarks trigger quarantine/repair proposals; production changes remain separately authorized.

layers.title: Lexical Retrieval Plane
layers.build_contract: Provide sparse retrieval with field-aware scoring, filters, deterministic baselines and explainable term evidence.
layers.acceptance_proof: Regression corpus preserves ranking invariants; authorization filtering occurs before candidate exposure.

layers.title: Dense Retrieval Plane
layers.build_contract: Provide embedding retrieval with versioned model/index identities, similarity semantics and compatibility guards.
layers.acceptance_proof: Embedding-version mismatch fails explicitly; recall/latency benchmarks bind model, index and corpus versions.

layers.title: Hybrid Fusion & Reranking
layers.build_contract: Fuse sparse, dense and metadata signals through calibrated, auditable ranking stages.
layers.acceptance_proof: Offline paired evaluation beats declared baselines without violating scope filters; reranker receipts expose contributing signals.

layers.title: Graph & Multi-Hop Retrieval
layers.build_contract: Traverse entity/relation/claim graphs with bounded hop budgets and evidence-preserving path construction.
layers.acceptance_proof: Synthetic and real graph tasks prove bounded expansion, cycle handling and path-level provenance.

layers.title: Temporal & Freshness-Aware Retrieval
layers.build_contract: Rank evidence using event time, valid time, freshness policy and source update semantics.
layers.acceptance_proof: Temporal queries return the correct historical/current slice and mark stale/unknown freshness rather than inventing recency.

layers.title: Code, Symbol & Multimodal Retrieval
layers.build_contract: Unify code symbols, documents, image regions, audio segments and other modality-specific chunks behind common evidence contracts.
layers.acceptance_proof: Cross-modal retrieval evals preserve exact source anchors and modality metadata; code symbol moves are version-aware.

layers.title: Source Quality & Provenance Scoring
layers.build_contract: Separate relevance from source trust, provenance completeness, licensing, freshness and known reliability history.
layers.acceptance_proof: Evaluator demonstrates that a highly relevant low-trust source cannot silently outrank mandatory provenance or policy constraints.

layers.title: Evidence Synthesis & Citation Entailment
layers.build_contract: Build answers from evidence units with claim-to-source mapping, contradiction handling and citation entailment checks.
layers.acceptance_proof: Citation verifier demonstrates each material claim is supported, contradicted or explicitly uncertain; unsupported synthesis fails qualification.

layers.title: Reasoning Strategy Router
layers.build_contract: Select direct, retrieval, decomposition, simulation, tool, verifier or multi-agent strategies under budget and risk constraints.
layers.acceptance_proof: Strategy traces show deterministic admissibility and measured utility; expensive paths are not invoked when cheaper qualified paths suffice.

layers.title: Task Decomposition Engine
layers.build_contract: Split complex objectives into bounded subproblems with explicit interfaces, dependencies and acceptance criteria.
layers.acceptance_proof: Decomposition tests detect missing dependencies, duplicated work and unbounded recursion before execution.

layers.title: Causal Reasoning Layer
layers.build_contract: Represent candidate causes, interventions and confounders distinctly from correlation or narrative explanation.
layers.acceptance_proof: Counterexample suites detect common causal fallacies; causal claims carry assumptions and evidence lineage.

layers.title: Counterfactual Reasoning Layer
layers.build_contract: Evaluate alternate states under explicit changed assumptions while preserving the baseline world state.
layers.acceptance_proof: Counterfactual runs are isolated, reproducible and labeled hypothetical; no simulated side effect can mutate production.

layers.title: Abductive & Analogical Reasoning
layers.build_contract: Generate competing explanations and analogies, then score structural fit and disconfirming evidence.
layers.acceptance_proof: Benchmarks reward correct mapping and penalize surface similarity; alternative hypotheses remain visible until resolved.

layers.title: Constraint & Formal Reasoning
layers.build_contract: Use SAT/SMT/type/property or domain solvers when problems admit formal structure, with model reasoning as proposal rather than proof.
layers.acceptance_proof: Formal claims include machine-checkable witness or explicit solver failure; model confidence cannot substitute for proof.

layers.title: Critic / Verifier Deliberation
layers.build_contract: Run bounded generator-critic-verifier cycles with role separation and non-self-promotion rules.
layers.acceptance_proof: Adversarial tests prove the generator cannot mark its own output verified; retry counts and termination reasons are durable.

layers.title: Uncertainty, Calibration & Stopping
layers.build_contract: Track epistemic/aleatoric uncertainty proxies, evidence gaps, calibration and expected value of further computation.
layers.acceptance_proof: Calibration curves, abstention tests and bounded stopping policies outperform fixed retry loops under cost/error targets.

layers.title: Goal Compiler
layers.build_contract: Translate objectives into typed goals, constraints, success metrics, forbidden states and terminal conditions.
layers.acceptance_proof: Goal mutation tests prove downstream agents cannot silently relax hard constraints or redefine success.

layers.title: Dependency-DAG Planner
layers.build_contract: Construct validated plan DAGs with preconditions, postconditions, capability requirements and explicit terminal states.
layers.acceptance_proof: Static analysis rejects cycles, unreachable nodes, missing capabilities and plans without terminal behavior.

layers.title: Hierarchical Planning
layers.build_contract: Support goal -> phase -> task -> step refinement while preserving ancestor constraints and budgets.
layers.acceptance_proof: Refinement proofs show child plans remain subsets of parent scope and budgets; cancellation propagates downward.

layers.title: Bounded Search Controller
layers.build_contract: Use beam, best-first, tree or Monte Carlo search only under explicit branching, depth, time and token budgets.
layers.acceptance_proof: Worst-case tests demonstrate hard bounds and stable termination; search state is checkpointable and inspectable.

layers.title: Simulation & World-Model Sandbox
layers.build_contract: Evaluate plans against isolated deterministic/stochastic simulators before privileged execution.
layers.acceptance_proof: Simulation cannot mutate authoritative state; model mismatch is measured and surfaced rather than hidden.

layers.title: Resource-Aware Scheduler
layers.build_contract: Schedule plan nodes using dependencies, deadlines, cost, hardware, rate limits, locality and priority classes.
layers.acceptance_proof: Load tests prove interactive priority, backpressure and fairness under saturation; starvation is detected and bounded.

layers.title: Plan Repair & Replanning
layers.build_contract: Repair invalidated plans from observed state while preserving completed work, constraints and evidence.
layers.acceptance_proof: Failure injection demonstrates minimal recomputation, no duplicate side effects and explicit supersession of stale plan nodes.

layers.title: Long-Horizon Checkpoint / Resume
layers.build_contract: Persist sufficient execution state to safely resume multi-hour/day operations across process or machine restarts.
layers.acceptance_proof: Crash/restart drills resume exactly once, preserve budgets/authority, and never replay committed side effects without idempotency proof.

layers.title: Capability & Tool Registry
layers.build_contract: Expose tools as versioned typed capabilities with schemas, risk class, side effects, owners and policy bindings.
layers.acceptance_proof: Registry validation rejects ambiguous names, incompatible schemas and undocumented side effects.

layers.title: Authorization & Approval Engine
layers.build_contract: Decide tool eligibility from principal, scope, data classification, risk, budget and required human approval.
layers.acceptance_proof: Privilege-escalation tests fail closed; approvals bind exact proposed action and expire on material mutation.

layers.title: Sandbox & Egress Boundary
layers.build_contract: Run untrusted or high-risk code/tools with filesystem, process, network, secret and resource boundaries.
layers.acceptance_proof: Escape, SSRF, path traversal, secret inheritance and resource-exhaustion suites remain contained.

layers.title: Idempotent Side-Effect Ledger
layers.build_contract: Reserve and record external side effects with idempotency keys, dedupe semantics and durable receipts.
layers.acceptance_proof: Retry storms cannot duplicate irreversible actions; uncertain commit states enter reconciliation instead of blind retry.

layers.title: Transactional / Saga Orchestration
layers.build_contract: Coordinate multi-system actions using prepare/commit where possible and compensation/saga semantics otherwise.
layers.acceptance_proof: Partial-failure drills converge to a declared terminal state with all committed/compensated steps evidenced.

layers.title: Connector Reliability Mesh
layers.build_contract: Standardize rate limits, pagination, retries, leases, webhooks, eventual consistency and provider-specific failure translation.
layers.acceptance_proof: Provider fault matrices show bounded retries, backoff, pagination completeness and no error-envelope leakage.

layers.title: Computer-Use & UI Action Control
layers.build_contract: Treat GUI/browser/desktop actions as privileged perception-action loops with screen-state identity and stale-state checks.
layers.acceptance_proof: Stale UI, double-click, focus theft and layout-shift tests prevent unintended actions; destructive actions require verified target state.

layers.title: Postcondition Verification & Action Receipts
layers.build_contract: Verify the world after each material tool action and persist before/after evidence, not merely tool-return success.
layers.acceptance_proof: Fault injection proves false-success responses are detected; receipts bind invocation, observed postcondition and final authority decision.

layers.title: Agent Identity & Role Isolation
layers.build_contract: Give each agent an explicit identity, role, objective scope, capabilities, memory policy and resource budget.
layers.acceptance_proof: Cross-role tests prove agents cannot inherit undeclared tools, memory or credentials.

layers.title: Delegation Contract
layers.build_contract: Delegate only a subset of parent authority with explicit objective, budget, deadline, return contract and revocation semantics.
layers.acceptance_proof: Delegation property tests reject authority amplification and preserve revocation across queued/running children.

layers.title: Lease, Fencing & Ownership
layers.build_contract: Protect mutable work through leases/fencing tokens so stale or duplicated workers cannot both commit.
layers.acceptance_proof: Split-brain and clock-skew tests prove stale owners are fenced before mutation.

layers.title: Handoff Packet & Continuity
layers.build_contract: Transfer tasks with canonical objective, state, evidence, open questions, constraints and accepted risks.
layers.acceptance_proof: Handoff round-trips preserve all hard constraints and unresolved blockers; implicit conversational state is insufficient.

layers.title: Bounded Parallelism & Fan-Out
layers.build_contract: Parallelize independent work under declared concurrency, collision domains and merge policies.
layers.acceptance_proof: Stress tests enforce fan-out ceilings, detect overlapping mutation domains and preserve cancellation/backpressure.

layers.title: Disagreement & Arbitration
layers.build_contract: Resolve conflicting agent outputs through evidence, role-aware arbitration and independent verification rather than majority confidence.
layers.acceptance_proof: Synthetic collusion and shared-error tests prevent false consensus from being promoted.

layers.title: Hierarchical Command Plane
layers.build_contract: Preserve Supervisor -> Secretary -> Worker authority with non-executing coordination boundaries and auditable task issuance.
layers.acceptance_proof: Boundary tests prove Supervisor/Secretary cannot bypass execution policy and Workers cannot rewrite parent authority.

layers.title: Swarm Recovery & Quorum Safety
layers.build_contract: Recover multi-agent operations from worker loss, duplicated messages, stale state and partial quorum without corrupting authority.
layers.acceptance_proof: Chaos tests demonstrate deterministic reassignment, no double commit and explicit degraded-mode semantics.

layers.title: Document & Image Vision
layers.build_contract: Parse layout, regions, tables, diagrams and images while preserving pixel/page anchors and OCR uncertainty.
layers.acceptance_proof: Document evals bind extracted claims to exact regions/pages and distinguish uncertain text from verified text.

layers.title: Speech & Audio Intelligence
layers.build_contract: Handle transcription, diarization, acoustic events and speech generation with timing, speaker and confidence metadata.
layers.acceptance_proof: Noise, overlap and speaker-switch tests preserve timestamps and uncertainty; generated speech is provenance-labeled.

layers.title: Video & Temporal Perception
layers.build_contract: Model events across frames with temporal anchors, scene changes, tracks and long-video summarization.
layers.acceptance_proof: Temporal QA and event localization benchmarks preserve frame/time evidence and avoid single-frame hallucinated continuity.

layers.title: Cross-Modal Fusion
layers.build_contract: Fuse text, image, audio, video and structured state while retaining modality-specific uncertainty and source identity.
layers.acceptance_proof: Conflict tests keep contradictory modalities explicit; fusion cannot erase lower-confidence provenance.

layers.title: Spatial / Scene Representation
layers.build_contract: Represent objects, relations, geometry, visibility, state and uncertainty in a deterministic scene/world graph.
layers.acceptance_proof: Round-trip fixtures preserve entity identity and topology; impossible transforms or ambiguous ownership fail explicitly.

layers.title: Interactive World / Computer Model
layers.build_contract: Maintain a perception-action world state for browser, desktop or simulated environments with stale-state detection.
layers.acceptance_proof: Refresh, resize, focus and external-change tests force re-observation before action when state identity changes.

layers.title: Cross-Modal Memory & Retrieval
layers.build_contract: Store and retrieve multimodal episodes/objects through shared entity and evidence identifiers.
layers.acceptance_proof: Cross-modal queries return modality anchors and respect deletion/retention across every derived index.

layers.title: Sensor Uncertainty & Provenance
layers.build_contract: Carry confidence, calibration, capture conditions, transformation lineage and missing-data semantics through multimodal pipelines.
layers.acceptance_proof: Corruption and missing-sensor tests never convert unknown into zero/false; transformed media remains lineage-linked.

layers.title: Outcome Telemetry
layers.build_contract: Capture task outcome, user correction, tool success, verifier results, latency, cost and recovery signals as governed learning events.
layers.acceptance_proof: Event schemas distinguish observation from label; missing/biased telemetry is quantified before optimization.

layers.title: Feedback Normalization
layers.build_contract: Convert explicit/implicit feedback into typed signals with source, scope, confidence, consent and anti-gaming controls.
layers.acceptance_proof: Conflicting and malicious feedback suites prevent direct production mutation and preserve minority/high-risk signals.

layers.title: Preference Modeling
layers.build_contract: Learn task/user/workspace preferences under privacy boundaries and with reversible, inspectable state.
layers.acceptance_proof: Preference drift tests separate stable preference from one-off instruction; deletion/export semantics remain correct.

layers.title: Adaptive Routing & Bandits
layers.build_contract: Optimize model/tool/strategy selection from outcomes using constrained bandit or policy methods under safety floors.
layers.acceptance_proof: Offline replay and canary tests demonstrate gain without violating non-compensable gates; exploration budgets are explicit.

layers.title: Prompt / Policy Candidate Optimization
layers.build_contract: Generate and compare prompt/policy candidates in sandboxed evaluation rather than editing production authority directly.
layers.acceptance_proof: Candidates require versioned datasets, scorers and independent promotion; benchmark overfit triggers rejection.

layers.title: Retrieval / Memory Adaptation
layers.build_contract: Tune ranking, chunking, promotion and retention policies from measured utility while preserving provenance and privacy.
layers.acceptance_proof: A/B or replay evidence proves utility gain; poisoning, feedback loops and catastrophic forgetting are tested.

layers.title: Online / Offline Adaptation Boundary
layers.build_contract: Separate immediate runtime adaptation, offline learned candidates and model-training changes with explicit data/authority boundaries.
layers.acceptance_proof: Tests prove online signals cannot silently mutate protected model/policy state; rollback restores the prior behavior bundle.

layers.title: Champion / Challenger Promotion
layers.build_contract: Promote learned candidates only through reproducible comparator evaluation, adversarial challenge, canary and rollback readiness.
layers.acceptance_proof: Promotion record binds candidate, baseline, dataset, scorer, code, policy, budget, verifier and rollback artifact.

layers.title: Provider-Neutral Model Contract
layers.build_contract: Normalize model requests/results, structured output, streaming, tools, errors, usage and cancellation behind stable core contracts.
layers.acceptance_proof: Adapter conformance tests prove provider objects do not escape boundary; unsupported capabilities degrade explicitly.

layers.title: Model Capability Router
layers.build_contract: Route by quality, modality, latency, cost, context, policy, residency, tool support and health.
layers.acceptance_proof: Counterfactual routing evals quantify tradeoffs; policy/residency constraints are hard filters, not weighted preferences.

layers.title: Inference Batching, Cache & Stream Runtime
layers.build_contract: Coordinate continuous batching, KV/prefix caches, streaming, cancellation and admission without cross-request leakage.
layers.acceptance_proof: Concurrency tests prove cache isolation, cancellation finality and bounded queue latency under saturation.

layers.title: Efficient Inference: Quantization & Speculation
layers.build_contract: Use quantization, speculative decoding and optimized kernels only with measured quality and deterministic fallback.
layers.acceptance_proof: Quality/performance gates compare against reference path; unsupported hardware or drift triggers safe fallback.

layers.title: Distributed Placement & Failover
layers.build_contract: Place inference/training work across workers using topology, locality, model shards, health and capacity with lease/fencing semantics.
layers.acceptance_proof: Node/GPU/network failure drills rehome work without duplicate finalization or silent quality downgrade.

layers.title: Heterogeneous Accelerator Fabric
layers.build_contract: Discover and schedule CPU, GPU, NPU, ASIC and vendor-specific accelerators through capability descriptors rather than hard-coded brands.
layers.acceptance_proof: Unknown hardware falls back safely; capability probing is versioned and benchmark-backed; memory/topology limits are enforced.

layers.title: Native Training & Post-Training
layers.build_contract: Support dataset lineage, pretraining/adaptation, SFT, preference/reward/verifier training, checkpointing and reproducibility under rights/privacy gates.
layers.acceptance_proof: Training run manifests reproduce data/code/config/hardware identities; contamination and checkpoint recovery tests pass.

layers.title: Model Lifecycle, Registry & Rollback
layers.build_contract: Govern registry, staging, canary, active, deprecated and retired models with compatibility and rollback contracts.
layers.acceptance_proof: Rollback drill restores exact prior model+adapter+policy bundle; stale clients receive compatible behavior or explicit refusal.

layers.title: Structural & Schema Verification
layers.build_contract: Validate types, schemas, invariants, state transitions and output structure before semantic acceptance.
layers.acceptance_proof: Malformed, partial and adversarial outputs fail deterministically; schema success is never treated as factual success.

layers.title: Factual & Evidence Verification
layers.build_contract: Verify claims against retrieved/known evidence with contradiction, uncertainty and source-quality handling.
layers.acceptance_proof: Independent verifier catches unsupported material claims and reports evidence gaps rather than fabricating support.

layers.title: Code / Action Verification
layers.build_contract: Execute tests, static analysis, sandbox checks and postconditions for code or real-world actions before acceptance.
layers.acceptance_proof: Generated code/actions cannot self-certify; exact-head/result identity binds all acceptance evidence.

layers.title: Adversarial & Red-Team Verification
layers.build_contract: Systematically challenge prompt injection, jailbreaks, poisoning, collusion, resource abuse, race conditions and recovery edges.
layers.acceptance_proof: Regression corpus is versioned; newly found failures become mandatory tests or explicit accepted-risk records.

layers.title: Prompt-Injection & Trust-Boundary Defense
layers.build_contract: Enforce instruction/data separation across retrieval, tools, connectors, files, web and agent handoffs.
layers.acceptance_proof: Indirect-injection suites show external content cannot authorize tools, alter policy or persist memory without an independent gate.

layers.title: Privacy, Tenant & Data-Use Governance
layers.build_contract: Enforce classification, minimization, retention, residency, consent, tenant isolation and purpose limitation end-to-end.
layers.acceptance_proof: Cross-tenant, export, deletion and residency tests produce zero unauthorized disclosure or orphaned derived data.

layers.title: Provenance & Supply-Chain Integrity
layers.build_contract: Bind code, model, dataset, artifact, dependency, build and release provenance with tamper-evident identities.
layers.acceptance_proof: SBOM/provenance verification, dependency substitution and artifact-tamper tests fail closed before promotion.

layers.title: Non-Compensable Promotion & Human Override
layers.build_contract: Make safety, privacy, authority, tenant isolation, state integrity, rollback and required human control absolute promotion gates.
layers.acceptance_proof: Scorecard tests prove quality/cost wins cannot compensate for a failed hard gate; override actions are scoped, signed and auditable.

layers.title: Full-Operation Observability & Replay
layers.build_contract: Reconstruct an operation from durable state plus logs, metrics, traces, receipts, decisions and version identities.
layers.acceptance_proof: Independent incident replay explains each critical transition and highlights any unobservable gap as a release blocker.

layers.title: SLO, Cost & Resource Governors
layers.build_contract: Enforce latency, reliability, cost, token, memory, GPU and queue budgets with admission, degradation and error-budget policies.
layers.acceptance_proof: Saturation tests show bounded tail behavior and declared degradation order; budget overruns cannot trigger unsafe fallback.

layers.title: Chaos, Recovery & Disaster Autonomy
layers.build_contract: Continuously rehearse worker loss, queue duplication, data-store outage, network partition, accelerator reset and restore/rollback paths.
layers.acceptance_proof: Game-day evidence proves RTO/RPO and exact-once/at-least-once semantics where declared; unrehearsed recovery blocks frontier qualification.

layers.title: Autonomous Research Loop
layers.build_contract: Run discovery -> evidence graph -> hypothesis -> experiment -> replication -> analysis -> challenge under bounded budgets and research integrity rules.
layers.acceptance_proof: Research candidates preserve negative results, citations, methods and uncertainty; no experiment promotes itself into production.

layers.title: Self-Improvement Candidate Factory
layers.build_contract: Generate code, routing, policy, prompt, dataset and model candidates from measured weaknesses, isolated from production authority.
layers.acceptance_proof: Every candidate has hypothesis, diff, expected metric, risk analysis, sandbox result and rejection path; direct self-modification is forbidden.

layers.title: Hundred-Trial Mirror Room
layers.build_contract: Challenge candidate behavior through at least 100 diverse adversarial/simulation attempts before frontier promotion, with attempt independence and failure clustering.
layers.acceptance_proof: Promotion evidence includes all attempts, seeds/scenarios, discovered failure classes and repair/retest lineage; cherry-picked passes are invalid.

layers.title: Cross-Domain Generalization & Specialist Ensemble
layers.build_contract: Combine general and specialist systems through evidence-aware routing while measuring transfer, interference and out-of-domain behavior.
layers.acceptance_proof: Held-out domain tests quantify gains and regressions; specialist consensus cannot override hard governance gates.

layers.title: Frontier Finality & Signed Release
layers.build_contract: Declare the 96-layer superstructure complete only when every layer is independently verified, current-evidence valid, rollback-ready and signed at exact head.
layers.acceptance_proof: Machine validator reports 96/96 qualified, no stale evidence, no failed hard gate, reproducible release identity and independent final signature.
